head: Planescope flight radar app for iPhone shows the planes above you
dek: Planescope: Live Air Traffic is a $1.99 flight radar app that shows the aircraft flying around you on an animated radar, turned to the direction you face. It was #62 among paid Travel apps on the US App Store on 21 November.
details: Tap a plane to see the airline, the aircraft model, a photo, where it's flying from and to, and its altitude and speed. The range goes from 5 to 300 km, there are six radar styles or a map view, and a vibration when a new plane enters your area. The same purchase includes an Apple Watch app, widgets and the Mac version. The flight data comes from community ADS-B receivers (adsb.lol), so coverage depends on your area; the listing says there's no account, no ads and no tracking. It came out on 4 November.
where: iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch and Mac, App Store, $1.99 once
means: If you often wonder where the plane overhead is going, this app answers it by pointing your phone at the sky.
todo: Coverage depends on volunteer receivers near you, so check that planes show up in your area soon after you buy.
